description: Source code for V4L2 video decode accelerator helpers, including format detection, image processor creation, pixmap size calculation, and NALU-based frame boundary detection for H264 and HEVC.

classes.name: InputBufferFragmentSplitter
classes.description: Base class for splitting input buffers into frames based on codec profile.

classes.name: H264InputBufferFragmentSplitter
classes.description: Handles frame boundary detection for H264 streams.

classes.name: HEVCInputBufferFragmentSplitter
classes.description: Handles frame boundary detection for HEVC streams.

methods.name: FindImageProcessorInputFormat
methods.description: Detects supported input format for image processing from V4L2 device.

methods.name: FindImageProcessorOutputFormat
methods.description: Detects supported output format for image processing from V4L2 device, prioritizing YVU420 and NV12.

methods.name: CreateImageProcessor
methods.description: Creates an ImageProcessor instance with specified formats and sizes.

methods.name: NativePixmapSizeFromHandle
methods.description: Calculates pixmap size from handle, format, and current size.

methods.name: InputBufferFragmentSplitter::CreateFromProfile
methods.description: Factory method to create appropriate buffer splitter based on video profile.

methods.name: H264InputBufferFragmentSplitter::AdvanceFrameFragment
methods.description: Determines frame boundary for H264 data.

methods.name: HEVCInputBufferFragmentSplitter::AdvanceFrameFragment
methods.description: Determines frame boundary for HEVC data.
